phases.title: Fix auth middleware: enforce Bearer prefix and remove eval()
phases.notes: Rewrote auth.ts: enforces Bearer prefix via startsWith('Bearer '), replaced eval()-based isValidToken with pure string/array digit-sum logic. Also included token length check (>200 chars → 401) since it is in the same file and function. All 19 tests pass.

phases.title: Add token length validation (>200 chars returns 401)
phases.notes: Already implemented in phase-1: auth.ts lines 16-19 check token.length > 200 and return 401. All 19 tests pass.

phases.title: Remove child_process.exec() command injection from productController
phases.notes: Removed exec() call and child_process import from productController.ts. Controller now only calls parseProductQuery, getAllProducts, and res.json. All 19 tests pass.

phases.title: Build and verify all tests pass
phases.notes: All 19 tests pass (vitest run). TypeScript build (tsc -p tsconfig.build.json) succeeds with no errors.
